Datadog's Implementation Services team helps customers deploy and realize value from the Datadog platform quickly. Our Project Managers are the engine behind that by running complex, multi-stakeholder engagements end-to-end and keeping projects on time and on scope.

As the manager of this team, you will lead a growing team of Senior Project Managers across North America. This is a true player/coach role: you'll manage and develop a team of three individuals, and run at least one customer engagement independently.

You'll set the standard for delivery quality, build strong partnerships with our internal go-to-market teams, and help shape how the practice scales.
At Datadog, we place value in our office culture — the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

Manage, develop, and mentor a team of Senior Project Managers, fostering a high-performance culture focused on delivery excellence and professional growth
Own overall delivery quality across your team's portfolio, tracking project health, proactively resolving blockers, and stepping in as an escalation point when needed
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Technical Account Management to ensure seamless handoffs, aligned expectations, and a world-class customer experience
Build and maintain strong relationships with sellers and pre-sales teams across North America to grow the pipeline of Implementation Services engagements
Connect directly with customers to champion our services, surface opportunities, and understand the impact of our program on their business
Drive initiatives to improve delivery frameworks, tooling, and playbooks so the team can scale without sacrificing quality

5-7 years of people management experience, with a track record of developing high-performing project managers or delivery professionals
Deep experience running complex, enterprise-level projects for SaaS implementations
Rigorous about the fundamentals: scope management, risk identification, stakeholder alignment, and proactive communication are second nature to you
Outstanding skills presenting to technical and executive audiences
Experience with planning and scoping deals in a pre-sales capacity
Able to travel via auto, train, or air up to 30% of the time across North America
Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about delivery and want to grow your leadership skills, we encourage you to apply.

Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Stripe Security team is dedicated to improving the security of Stripe and its users. Our users trust us with some of their most sensitive information, and we make security a first-class consideration in everything we do. Security concerns are ever-evolving, creating an extremely dynamic environment for the Security team.
The Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (SGRC) team at Stripe provides security governance, risk management, and compliance capabilities to allow Stripe to make strategic security decisions, measure our risk and control posture, and represent Stripe Security to internal and external entities. The successful operation of our organization accelerates Stripe by optimizing the communication and expectations of our security program.

We're looking for a Security GRC Program Manager with deep expertise in security compliance to serve as the primary interface between Stripe's Security organization and external auditors, regulators, and compliance stakeholders. In this role, you'll represent the Security team in audit engagements, articulate how Stripe's security controls are designed and how they operate, and ensure that compliance obligations across a complex global regulatory landscape are met with consistency and rigor.
In this role, you will act as a proxy between external entities like regulators and auditors, and our internal security teams, ensuring consistency in compliance responses and helping maintain a lean and effective compliance program. The ideal candidate is adaptable and finds structure in an evolving and maturing organization.

Act as an information security subject matter expert during cross-functional audit engagements, representing the Security team in walkthrough meetings with auditors and regulators
Serve as the internal liaison (proxy) between and the Security organization to ensure audits are managed effectively and consistently
Create and maintain a central repository of audit evidence artifacts required for compliance with SOC 2, PCI DSS, SOX, and other global regulatory standards
Perform security risk and control assessments against common frameworks to ensure compliance with Stripe's Information Security Policy and Standards and applicable regulations (e.g., ISO 2700x, PCI DSS, SOX, NIST, COBIT)
Support control owners with guidance on security control design and redesign to ensure continued compliance and effectiveness
Facilitate security compliance support for Stripe's legal entities with regulatory obligations, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to track and report on control remediation efforts
Support broader GRC team program initiatives, including policy writing, security awareness training, and third-party security risk assessments

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Subject matter expert in information security frameworks, practices, policies, standards, and procedures (e.g., NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/2, or equivalent)
6+ years of experience in Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance or Technology Compliance roles with a strong understanding of audit processes
Exposure to global regulatory requirements (e.g., DORA, FFIEC, EBA, NYDFS) and experience integrating them into compliance programs
Experience conducting security audits and supporting compliance across complex, overlapping regulatory frameworks
Strong program management skills with proficiency in coordinating security assessments and managing multiple stakeholder engagements across time zones
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build relationships at all levels and translate technical security concepts for auditors, regulators, and executive audiences

At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements.

If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.
This role is based in our Boston office — and it's one of the most visible things we're building right now.
Klaviyo's engineering org is scaling fast, and we're making a deliberate bet on AI-first engineering. We don't want AI to be something engineers use occasionally, we want it embedded in how every engineer at Klaviyo works from day one. This is the role that makes that happen.
You’ll help every engineer at Klaviyo move faster with more confidence—by design, not by accident. If you love building systems that enable outsized impact and enjoy teaching others how to win, this is the role. This IC role sits at the heart of engineering effectiveness.

You’ll partner closely with Developer Infrastructure, Eng Leadership, HRBP, Recruiting/RCs, L&D, Security, and peers in Engineering Operations (e.g., Tools & Metrics) to translate insights into programs, tAI ooling, and rituals that help teams deliver.
Build the systems, onboarding, and learning programs that make every Klaviyo engineer productive from day one—and more effective every quarter. You’ll design an AI‑first onboarding and enablement experience, standardize “how engineering works” at Klaviyo, and run experiments that measurably improve developer velocity, quality, and satisfaction. The result: faster ramps, fewer friction points, and a culture of continuous improvement across R&D.
How you’ll make a difference
Own engineering team onboarding and time-to-impact. Design and run a Day 0 through Day 30/60/90 onboarding experience that is AI-first by default, including environments, access, labs, first PRs, and success metrics. Reduce time-to-first-impact and ensure a consistent, high-quality ramp for new engineers, in close partnership with L&D.
Enable embedding AI into daily engineering workflows like backlog and PR synthesis, and incident summaries. Partner closely with Developer Infrastructure and Engineering Leadership to operationalize AI in ways that align with platform direction. Pilot tools, measure adoption and impact, and share playbooks that lift team productivity.
Codify how engineering works. Build and maintain living training and documentation that explain our engineering systems, development lifecycle, code review norms, CI and release practices, and incident hygiene, so teams can move fast in the same direction.
Design and scale technical learning programs. Create, pilot, and iterate on learning paths, workshops, demos, and lunch-and-learns that build fluency in AI and emerging technologies. Use stakeholder input and program data to continuously improve and scale what works.
Enable engineering manager effectiveness. Translate Klaviyo’s leadership expectations to Engineering. Design and deliver learning and enablement for Engineering Managers focused on how engineering operates, including planning and execution norms, tooling, metrics, onboarding new team members, and leading effectively within Klaviyo’s engineering system. Partner with HRBP and L&D to diagnose the needs and customize content specific to technical leadership.
Facilitate high-impact live learning. Lead engaging, audience-appropriate learning sessions for engineers and engineering managers, incorporate feedback, and evolve content to maximize relevance and impact.
Define and track enablement success. Establish north-star metrics and success criteria for onboarding, learning, and productivity initiatives. Use data, qualitative feedback, and experimentation to assess impact, surface trade-offs, and recommend next steps.
Partner on onboarding delivery and iteration. Facilitate engineering onboarding on a rotating basis, ensure smooth execution, and share feedback with onboarding DRIs. Maintain and evolve onboarding documentation, content, and training materials.
Strengthen the recruiting-to-onboarding handoff. Partner with Recruiting and RCs to align competencies, interview assessments and starter projects so new hires are set up to succeed from day one.
Elevate engineering culture and learning. Enable tech talks, internal workshops, and communities of practice that spread best practices, reinforce learning norms, and raise the bar on craft and collaboration. Partner closely with HRBP, EBP, and Engineering Leadership.
Communicate clearly and consistently. Craft timely, high-quality communications for engineering programs and initiatives, including announcements, updates, and internal resources, ensuring clarity, consistency, and discoverability.

Technical practitioner and systems thinker. You’ve been an engineer or worked very closely with engineering and truly understand the workflow; you understand IDEs, Git, CI/CD, testing, and can break down technical systems for others. You care about measurable impact, reliability, and developer productivity.
Operator‑teacher. Clear writer and facilitator who creates clarity, reduces ambiguity, and equips others with crisp guidance, examples, and artifacts.
Outcome‑oriented and accountable. You model ownership, intensity, and urgency; you push work to closure and measure results, not just activity.
Collaborative across functions. Comfortably partners with Eng Leaders, Dev Infra, Product, HRBP, Recruiting/RCs, L&D, and Security; aligns to Klaviyo values and is motivated by winning as a team..
Preferred experience (guidance, not gates): 5–8+ years across software engineering, developer productivity/enablement, platform/dev‑tools, or engineering operations; experience designing onboarding/bootcamps or developer education is a plus.

Experience measuring and improving developer experience (e.g., review SLAs, CI stability, environment setup) and publishing impact metrics.
Hands‑on with CI/CD and modern SDLC tooling; ability to script/lightweight automate workflows.
Program design for learning (labs, guilds, workshops) and strong technical writing portfolio.
Experience rolling out AI tools internally and establishing responsible‑use guardrails.

You will be well-versed in all aspects of event strategy, planning, and execution and will lead both in-person and virtual events that boost regional recruiting efforts and elevate our brand awareness across North America and Latin America.

Organize and coordinate all aspects of event execution, including set-up for both in-person and virtual formats
Deliver creative and engaging event experiences that drive talent pipeline generation, boost brand visibility, and foster retention
Contribute to content and campaign efforts and work cross-functionally with the Employer Brand team to support the overall strategy

The Program Manager's contributions are instrumental in the successful implementation and management of the WRI LMR ASTRO System, ensuring efficient operations and effective collaboration across all stakeholders. Knowledge of the Motorola ecosystem is ideal as this role will be the Gatekeeper for all ecosystem opportunities in this space.

Preference will be given to applicants in the Western Region.
Program Manager position is responsible for the management, oversight and overall administration of the ASTRO System which supports the USMC Enterprise LMR system, E911 systems and MBR radios globally.
Oversee and ensure that all contract requirements are met, the systems are maintained at required operational levels and general operation of the entire business.

Manage supply chain and logistics, strategic planning, customer service, contract management.

Dedrone stands out as the global leader in airspace defense technology and counter-UAS solutions. Engineering at Dedrone is tasked with delivering innovative solutions and products to maintain our position on the cutting edge of innovation.
Engineering Program Managers, Solutions at Dedrone own the delivery of next generation cUAS engineering solutions from requirements definition through deployment, driving programs that are highly visible to even the most senior executives.

This role sits at the intersection of product, internal engineering, and external development partners: taking requirements from product management, aligning them with internal technical teams, and directing outside development partners (ODM/CM and technical solution providers) to design, develop, and deliver the resulting engineering solutions.
This role emphasizes vendor and program management, requirements translation, partner alignment, and cross-functional execution across the full solutions development lifecycle. The ideal candidate combines strong hardware program management fundamentals with hands-on experience managing external development partners, ensuring that vendor-delivered work meets technical requirements, schedule, and quality bars.

Translate product requirements from Product Management into clear technical scopes, then align internal Systems, Electrical, and Mechanical Engineering teams and external development partners around a shared execution plan.
Own the master schedule for solutions programs delivered in partnership with outside development partners (ODM/CM and technical solution providers), driving milestones across all program phases (EVT, DVT, PVT).
Serve as the primary program interface to external development partners — managing scope, technical reviews, and deliverable acceptance to ensure vendor output meets Dedrone's requirements.
Identify, track, and proactively mitigate program risks from partner capability gaps and long-lead component constraints to supplier qualification gaps before they become schedule or cost impacts.
Own program budget management including NRE, tooling, and build costs, maintaining alignment between vendor commitments and business objectives.
Collaborate regularly with both domestic and international stakeholders, including ODM/CM and other development partners, to ensure manufacturing readiness and on-time production ramp.
Translate complex technical status, vendor tradeoffs, and program risk into clear, actionable communication for executive and cross-functional audiences.
Work autonomously and collaboratively in an empowering and fast-paced environment, driving clarity in ambiguous situations.
Hone your program and vendor management expertise in a dynamic learning environment focused on personal and professional development.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field; MBA or MS in Engineering Management a plus.
PMP certification a plus.
Proven experience managing hardware or technical solutions programs delivered through external development partners, preferably in industries involving advanced electromechanical systems.
Strong technical fluency across mechanical, electrical, and firmware disciplines sufficient to translate product requirements, evaluate vendor tradeoffs, and engage meaningfully with internal engineering teams.
Demonstrated experience managing ODM/CM or outside development partner relationships, including scoping, technical reviews, deliverable acceptance, and coordinating manufacturing readiness activities such as yield, regulatory certification, and factory acceptance.
Familiarity with hardware build phases (EVT/DVT/PVT), design freeze processes, and the tradeoffs inherent in transitioning from development to production.
Proficiency with program management tools for scheduling, risk tracking, and cross-functional coordination.
Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., FCC, CE, UL, MIL-STD) and experience driving vendor-delivered products through certification processes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to identify critical path risks — including those originating with external partners — and drive resolution across competing organizational priorities.
Excellent communication skills to effectively align product managers, internal engineering teams, and external development partners, surface tradeoffs to leadership, and present program status with clarity and confidence.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with high levels of ambiguity and evolving requirements.
Work Location
This role is based out of our Sterling, VA office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with organizational standards, policies, objectives, and governance requirements.

Manage implementation risks, dependencies, change impacts, and adoption activities.
IT Service Management (ITSM)

Coordinate ITSM process development and implementation across service management, technical, operational, and business teams.
Support the implementation and adoption of processes such as incident management, problem management, change management, request fulfillment, configuration management, and service reporting.

Risk & Governance Management

Warum diese Rolle
Lucid Labs ist eine spezialisierte Beratung für den deutschen Mittelstand. Wir automatisieren operative Entscheidungen, mit angewandter KI und einer eigenen Plattform, die bei Kunden produktiv läuft. Unsere Pipeline wächst schneller als unser Team. Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere Kundenprojekte übernimmt und in den nächsten zwölf Monaten in die volle Verantwortung für eigene Kunden hineinwächst.
Dabei sind wir besonders stolz auf unsere Geschwindigkeit. Von der Idee bis zum Piloten beim Kunden dauert es bei uns rund eine Woche. Den Hebel, den du im Workshop identifizierst, testet der Kunde nächste Woche als Prototyp. Direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und ohne Layer dazwischen.
Der eigentliche Grund für diese Rolle ist aber ein anderer: Hier wirst du AI-native. Du lernst, KI-Lösungen nicht nur theoretisch zu empfehlen und auf Folien aufzuzeigen, sondern selbst zu bauen, und berätst Unternehmen genau dabei. Das ist der Skill, der in den nächsten Jahren entscheidet, welche Berater gefragt sind. Und kaum ein Ort bringt ihn dir schneller bei als ein Team, das jede Woche selbst baut, was es berät.
Wenn du heute Rollouts, Implementierungen oder Digitalisierungsprojekte betreust und dabei mehr verwaltest als gestaltest: Genau dafür ist diese Rolle gedacht.
Aufgaben
Du übernimmst Kundenprojekte: Discovery, Workshops, laufende Implementierung. In den ersten Wochen gemeinsam mit jemandem, der das schon kann, danach allein. Mehrere Kunden parallel, mit deutlich mehr Tiefe pro Kunde als im klassischen Beratungsgeschäft. Du berichtest direkt an den Gründer und arbeitest eng mit unserem Engineering-Team. Das heißt Entscheidungswege von Minuten, nicht von Wochen.
70 % Kundenarbeit: Du bist Ansprechperson für deine Projekte, meist direkt für die Geschäftsführung unserer Kunden. Workshops vorbereiten und leiten, wöchentliche Calls, Demos, Scoping, Anforderungen ins Engineering übersetzen. Dein Maßstab: Deine Kunden arbeiten nach wenigen Wochen messbar anders.
20 % Prototyping: Erste Prototypen baust du selbst, mit modernen AI-Tools und ohne Programmierung. Das ist die Folie, die funktioniert. Wie das geht, lernst du bei uns — und es ist der Teil der Rolle, in dem du am schnellsten wächst.
10 % Pre-Sales & Scoping: Workshops sind bei uns auch ein Sales-Tool. Du bereitest Opportunities mit vor, bist in Angebotsgesprächen dabei und übernimmst mit der Zeit die Folgepotenziale bei deinen eigenen Bestandskunden.
Und weil wir in der Aufbau-Phase sind: Was du in deinen Projekten an Vorlagen, Checklisten und Abläufen entwickelst, wird zum Standard, nach dem das Delivery-Team danach arbeitet.
Deine ersten Monate
In den ersten 6–8 Wochen läufst du in laufenden Projekten mit, übernimmst schrittweise einzelne Workshops und Calls und lernst unsere Tools - nicht in einer Schulung, sondern an echten Kunden, mit jemandem daneben. Nach etwa drei Monaten führst du 2–3 Kundenprojekte selbst, mit einem Sparringspartner im Rücken.

Nach sechs Monaten trägst du deine Kunden allein und kannst Dinge, die du am Anfang nicht konntest: einen Prozess auseinandernehmen, einen Prototyp bauen, eine Geschäftsführerin durch eine Entscheidung führen.
Qualifikation
2–4 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit Kundenkontakt, zum Beispiel als Implementation oder Onboarding Consultant im B2B-SaaS, in der Rollout- oder ERP-Beratung, in einer Digital- oder Prozessberatung, oder als Projektmanager:in / Chief of Staff für Digitalisierungsprojekte im Mittelstand
Mindestens ein Kundenprojekt von Kick-off bis Go-Live getragen, mit deinem Namen am Ergebnis.
Erfahrung damit, selbst vorne zu stehen: Workshops, Schulungen, Anforderungsrunden oder Demos, die du vorbereitet und geleitet hast
Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, auch dann, wenn dir niemand vorgibt, wie die Struktur aussehen soll
Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und eine Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland in Vollzeit. Unsere Kunden sind deutscher Mittelstand, Workshops und Calls laufen auf Deutsch.
Englisch brauchst du auf solidem Arbeitsniveau, weil Tools und Dokumentation englisch sind
Technische Neugier: Du probierst neue Tools selbst aus. ChatGPT oder Claude nutzt du bereits regelmäßig
Was du nicht mitbringen musst: Kein Informatikstudium, keine Coding-Erfahrung, kein abgeschlossenes KI-Projekt, keine Beratungsmarke im Lebenslauf.
Was wir nicht beibringen können: dass du einen Raum hältst, wenn du vorne stehst. Und die Neugier, KI aktiv und wertstiftend einzusetzen. Uns interessiert weniger, wo du startest, als wie schnell du dich bewegst.
Plus, kein Muss: Eigene kleine Builds mit AI-Tools (Claude, n8n, Lovable), Erfahrung mit Kunden aus dem Mittelstand, Pre-Sales-Erfahrung, Change Management.
Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn: du Projekte am liebsten über Monate durchplanst, bevor etwas beim Kunden ankommt. Wenn du Beratung als Analyse verstehst und die Umsetzung anderen überlässt. Wenn du eine fertige Rollenbeschreibung und einen definierten Prozess brauchst, um loszulegen. Oder wenn du Kundengespräche eher meidest als suchst.

AI-native werden. Du baust den Skill auf, den gerade jede Beratung und jedes Unternehmen sucht, und wendest ihn jede Woche bei echten Kunden an. Neue Tools landen bei uns nicht in einer Roadmap, sondern noch in derselben Woche in einem echten Projekt.
Lernen als Teil der Arbeit, nicht daneben. Du arbeitest von Anfang an neben Leuten, die das schon können — im Projekt, nicht im Seminar. Was du fragst, wird beantwortet. Was du baust, bekommt Feedback.
Direkter Impact. Du arbeitest unmittelbar mit den Entscheidern: mit der Geschäftsführung beim Kunden, mit dem Gründer bei uns. Deine Empfehlungen werden umgesetzt, nicht archiviert, und du siehst das Ergebnis innerhalb von Wochen.
Planbare Intensität. Wir arbeiten fokussiert, aber berechenbar: keine Pitch-Wochenenden, keine Sonntag-Final-Edits. Kundenworkshops finden überwiegend remote statt, Reisen sind die Ausnahme.
Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad. Aus dieser Rolle wächst in 12–18 Monaten die volle Verantwortung für eigene Kunden — und danach die Möglichkeit, das Delivery-Team mit aufzubauen.
Ein Gründer, der es schon einmal gemacht hat. Marek war Mitgründer von Flightright, bis zum erfolgreichen Exit.
Remote mit Berlin als Basis. Du arbeitest, wo du willst. Mittwochs treffen wir uns als Team im EDGE Coworking am Hauptbahnhof. Wer weiter weg wohnt, kommt nach Absprache seltener, und wer gern im Office arbeitet, kann jederzeit häufiger da sein.
Wer wir sind
Lucid Labs ist ein AI-first Studio, gegründet von Marek Janetzke. Wir arbeiten selbst so, wie wir beraten: mit Cursor, Claude und den jeweils besten Tools im Alltag. Unsere Kultur: Ownership statt Micromanagement. Lieber in zwei Wochen eine smarte Wette machen und daraus lernen, als drei Monate etwas polieren, das niemand validiert hat. Wir teilen unser Wissen und lernen gleichzeitig gemeinsam als Team. Wir suchen Leute, die mitdenken, nicht nur mitarbeiten.
Bewerbung
Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Wenn du schon mal etwas mit AI-Tools gebaut hast, freuen wir uns über einen Link oder Screenshot — Pflicht ist es nicht.

Anthropic is bringing data center capacity online faster than the industry has ever attempted, and the owner-furnished equipment (OFE) that makes a site live — switchgear, transformers, UPS, generators, busway, PDUs, chillers, CDUs, air handlers, dry coolers, pumps and piping skids — is long-lead, high-value, and sits squarely on the construction critical path. When a transformer slips three weeks at the factory, a data hall slips three weeks at the site.
We're hiring a Supply Chain Delivery Manager to own that equipment from purchase order to dock.

You will be the site-facing supply chain lead for a regional portfolio of data center projects: tracking every OFE line item against the construction schedule, running factory and logistics escalations with OEMs, holding suppliers and general contractors accountable for delivery performance, and giving leadership a clear, converged picture of delivery risk across the portfolio.

Your job is to make sure equipment production and delivery are never the reason a site misses its ready-for-service date.
This is a senior individual-contributor role on the Compute DC Infrastructure team, working daily with Construction, Electrical and Mechanical Engineering, Strategic Sourcing, Commissioning, and our general contractors and OEMs. It is not a category-management or negotiation role — Sourcing owns supplier strategy and commercial terms — and it is not a people-management role. The emphasis is execution: schedules, escalations, logistics, and site readiness.

Delivery planning and schedule integration
Own the end-to-end OFE delivery plan for each site in your portfolio: order placement, engineering submittal/approval milestones, production slots, FAT dates, ship dates, and required-on-site (ROS) dates, integrated with the GC's construction schedule.
Engage during preconstruction with Construction, Engineering, and the GC to set OFE delivery expectations, sequence equipment arrivals to the build, and identify schedule risk before POs are cut.
Lead OFE kickoff meetings at the site level with the GC and internal construction teams, establishing points of contact, delivery windows, receiving requirements, and escalation paths.
Maintain the single source of truth for OFE status across the portfolio — a live tracker of every line item, its milestone dates, and its risk rating.
Supplier execution and escalation
Run weekly delivery cadences with OEMs and integrators on open orders; verify production progress against committed slots rather than accepting reported dates at face value.
Act as the primary escalation point for factory slips, component shortages, FAT failures, and shipping delays; drive recovery plans (expedites, partial ships, resequencing, alternate sources) with Sourcing and Engineering.
Partner with Sourcing on corporate-level supplier escalations, bringing site-level schedule intelligence to commercial conversations.
Hold GC OFCI teams accountable for receiving, storage, and installation-readiness performance; manage the change/claim process when delivery issues affect the GC's schedule.
Logistics and site readiness
Plan and coordinate transportation for oversize/overweight and high-value equipment — carrier selection, route surveys, permits, crane and rigging coordination — with our logistics partners and the GC.
Manage laydown, staging, and interim storage decisions when site readiness and equipment arrival diverge; coordinate with Quality and Commissioning on receiving inspection and storage/preservation requirements.
Ensure equipment arrives complete — accessories, spares, documentation, and vendor startup support scheduled — so installation and commissioning are not delayed by missing pieces.
Risk management and reporting
Identify, triage, and report delivery risks across the portfolio; propose solutions and drive decisions to protect capacity milestones.
Establish and lead recurring Capacity Delivery Reviews giving leadership converged visibility into OFE delivery status and risk by site and by equipment category.
Track delivery KPIs — on-time-to-ROS, schedule drift by supplier and category, escalation cycle time, expedite spend — and use them to surface systemic issues.
Feed lessons learned back into Sourcing (lead-time assumptions, contract delivery terms, buffer strategy) and Construction (ROS sequencing) to improve the next program.

**About Syngenta**
At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges.

We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact.

Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest. **Syngenta has been ranked as a-top employer-by Science Magazine and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.**
## Job Description ##
At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. To support this mission, we are seeking a **Global Environmental Technology Lead**. This is a hybrid role based primarily in Muttenz, Switzerland, though Monthey can also be considered.
As Global Environmental Technology Lead, you will shape how Production & Supply identifies, develops and deploys the technologies that reduce environmental impact while protecting operational performance and our license to operate.

This is a high-impact global role for an accomplished scientist or engineer who can move confidently between technical depth, strategic direction and practical implementation. You will connect manufacturing sites, process development, environmental specialists and external partners to turn complex environmental challenges into scalable solutions.

* Set the global environmental technology strategy across waste, wastewater, air emissions, vent treatment, recovery and recycling, informed by Best Available Techniques (BAT).
* Identify, assess and mature emerging technologies, taking opportunities from laboratory and pilot-scale evidence through to robust manufacturing application.
* Partner with global and local manufacturing teams to solve critical environmental challenges, improve site performance and safeguard license to operate.
* Provide technical leadership and independent challenge for environmental projects, assessing feasibility, environmental benefit, risk, operability and cost.
* Influence product and process choices early by evaluating waste streams, especially wastewater, during active-ingredient process development.
* Develop practical, high-value solutions that reduce impacts to air, water and land across existing products and manufacturing sites.
* Build and lead a connected global environmental technology community spanning Technology & Engineering, Production & Supply, Environmental Managers, process development teams and external experts.
* Grow internal capabilities through technical coaching, knowledge exchange, training, literature reviews and partnerships with suppliers, consultants and technology providers.
* Translate complex environmental science and regulation into clear choices and decisive action for technical and business stakeholders.

* Master-s degree, or equivalent, in Chemistry, Chemical Process Engineering or a related discipline.
* Ideally 10+ years- experience in industrial chemical operations and/or process development.
* Demonstrated expertise in environmental technologies and a practical understanding of environmental legislation.
* Able to remain focused, resilient and effective in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Strong knowledge of waste, wastewater, emissions, recovery and recycling technologies.
* Solid grounding in organic and inorganic chemistry, chemical processes and process engineering; agrochemical production knowledge is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of environmental toxicity, chemical bio-transformation and environmental risk assessment.
* Proven ability to lead teams or workstreams in project, departmental or matrix environments.
* Experience in project and change management, with resilience in ambiguous environments.
* Strong analytical, conceptual, organisational and negotiation skills.
* Clear communication and stakeholder-influencing skills at all levels.
* Experience working across multicultural, multinational teams, with a recognised record of technical delivery.
* Fluent business English; French is highly advantageous.
## Additional Information ##

We offer a variety of financial and non-financial benefits including:
* We offer a position which contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment
* The opportunity to make a difference to process safety, both within Syngenta-s global operations, and in shaping safety legislation and culture worldwide
* A super working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce where new ideas are always welcome
* The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees and gain scientific and technical excellence
* Learning culture (Together we Grow) and wide range of training options
* You will profit from a competitive pension fund plan, flexible working, attractive bonus system, onsite doctor, fitness room, canteen, and other benefits (Family friendly initiatives, Child and Family allowance-)

Das Beschwerdemanagement ist Teil des Teams Customer Excellence und leistet einen wichtigen Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Kundenerlebnisse bei der Allianz Suisse.
Du nimmst Beschwerden entgegen, erfasst diese im System und stellst eine strukturierte Bearbeitung durch die zuständigen Facheinheiten sicher. Komplexere Fälle übernimmst du teilweise selbst, klärst diese funktionsübergreifend und sorgst für eine transparente sowie zeitgerechte Kommunikation gegenüber unseren Kundinnen und Kunden.

In dieser Rolle bist du Teil eines kleinen, engagierten Teams, das eigenverantwortlich und lösungsorientiert arbeitet. Dabei bringst du deine Erfahrung aktiv ein und trägst dazu bei, aus Kundenfeedback gezielt Verbesserungen abzuleiten.
**Das kannst du bewirken**
* Du nimmst Kundenbeschwerden entgegen, stellst eine strukturierte Triage sicher und koordinierst die effiziente Bearbeitung durch die zuständigen Facheinheiten
* Du bearbeitest komplexe Beschwerden eigenständig, führst interne Abklärungen durch und unterstützt aktiv bei der Erarbeitung nachhaltiger Lösungen

* Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Problemfelder und gibst diese an das Customer Experience Team weiter, damit gezielte Verbesserungen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden angestossen werden können
* Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung und Durchführung des E-Learnings für dezentrale Beschwerdemanagerinnen und -manager und unterstützt bei der Aufbereitung von Erkenntnissen, Handlungsempfehlungen und Präsentationen für unterschiedliche Stakeholder unter Einsatz moderner AI-gestützter Arbeitsmethoden
**Das bringst du mit**
* Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise in der Versicherungsbranche; eine Weiterbildung (HF/FH) oder ein Bachelorabschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Versicherungswirtschaft, Kommunikation oder Customer Experience ist von Vorteil

**About Beyond Gravity**
Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality.

Approximately 1800 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond.

Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. In 2024, the company generated a revenue of around CHF 359 million. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com
**Your Crew**
Join our multidisciplinary team of 60+ engineers, where you-ll develop cutting-edge launcher structures for the payloads of tomorrow. You-ll work in a cross-cultural environment, serving a global customer base and engaging with a broad range of technologies.

Our collaborative and lean organisation fosters creativity and professional growth, supported by highly skilled experts. Here, you-ll have the opportunity to outperform yourself and learn something new every day, as each day brings unique chances to go Beyond.

The Operational Engineering Manager is a people-focused engineering leadership role, leading and developing an international team of around 30 Design and Analysis engineers at the heart of Beyond Gravity-s launcher activities in Switzerland.

As part of a 60+ Engineering organization, the team contributes to the development of launcher structures and critical separation systems, from early concepts through detailed engineering, qualification and industrialization support.

Reporting to the Senior Manager Development Engineering, the Operational Engineering Manager is accountable for people leadership, talent development, team health, capability growth and disciplined engineering execution.

The role creates the structure, routines and clarity needed for engineers to perform, while working closely with Lead Engineers, who retain technical ownership.

· Support focus topics and unforeseen operational tasks such as claim management, non-conformances, root-cause analysis and recovery actions. Ensure lessons learned are translated into concrete corrective and preventive actions.
· Own engineering process adherence and improvement, ensuring activities comply with company standards, customer requirements, Quality Management System requirements, guidelines and best practices.

# Manager:in digitale Kanäle 80 - 100% #
Suchst du eine Herausforderung im Umfeld von Politik und Verwaltung, am digitalen Puls der Zeit, bei einer Arbeitgeberin mit Themen so vielfältig wie das Leben?
Die Direktion der Justiz und des Innern (JI) erfüllt eine Vielfalt von Aufgaben, von A wie Archivwesen bis Z wie Zivilstandswesen. Bei uns im Generalsekretariat laufen die Fäden zusammen. Wir unterstützen die Direktionsvorsteherin und unsere Einheiten, bearbeiten Querschnittsthemen und begleiten und führen Programme und Projekte.
Im Januar 2027 tritt das revidierte Verwaltungsrechtspflegegesetz in Kraft, das vorsieht, dass Verwaltungsverfahren neu auch digital über spezielle elektronische Kanäle abgewickelt werden. Mit RRB Nr. 433/2026 wurde ein wichtiger Meilenstein für die Implementierung dieser elektronischen Kanäle im Kanton Zürich erreicht: Im Projekt VRGo wird die neue technische Lösung «VerfahrenZH» aufgebaut, welche die rechtskonforme Abwicklung von Verwaltungsverfahren ermöglicht.
Um den organisationsübergreifenden Aufbau dieser Lösung seitens der JI zu begleiten, und um im Betrieb der Lösung die Anforderungen unserer Verwaltungseinheiten fachgerecht bei den zuständigen Stellen einzubringen, suchen wir per 1. Oktober 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung im Generalsekretariat eine Person mit technischem Hintergrund als Manager/in digitale Kanäle (80 - 100 %).
### Deine Hauptaufgaben ###
* Du stehst proaktiv im Austausch mit den verfahrensführenden Stellen der JI und identifizierst, koordinierst und priorisierst ihre Anforderungen an die elektronischen Kanäle. Diese bringst du in die Projekte zu deren Weiterentwicklung und in übergreifende Digitalisierungsvorhaben ein.
* Du kennst die relevanten Fachapplikationen der JI und unterstützt allfällige Weiterentwicklungen und Anbindungen in Zusammenhang mit den elektronischen Kanälen.
* Du bist in der JI, im Kanton und im Bund mit den relevanten Stellen vernetzt und über bedeutsame Entwicklungen auf dem Laufenden.
* Du berätst und unterstützt die Verwaltungseinheiten der JI bei der weiteren Digitalisierung ihrer Verwaltungsverfahren. Dazu begleitest du die Umsetzung neuer oder weiterentwickelter Funktionalitäten aus Nutzendensicht und stehst in engem Austausch mit den Fachbereichen, Legal, IT-/Betriebsteams und weiteren Stakeholdern.
### Dein Profil ###
* Tertiäre Ausbildung (z.B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Rechtswissenschaften), mit Erfahrung in der Digitalisierung von Prozessen, Dienstleistungen oder Kommunikationskanälen (vorzugsweise in der Verwaltung oder im juristischen Bereich)
* Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse der Nutzenden sowie für serviceorientierte Gestaltung, stark in Koordination und Stakeholder-Management
* Schnelle Auffassungsgabe sowie eine analytische, strukturierte und konzeptionelle Arbeitsweise mit Freude an der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung digitaler Lösungen
* Ganzheitliches Denken, hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative und hohe Eigenverantwortung mit proaktivem Arbeitsverständnis
### Unser Angebot ###
* Eine vielseitige und sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einem motivierten Team
* Gelebte flache Hierarchien und flexible Home-Office-Regelungen
* Spannende Einblicke in die vielseitigen Tätigkeiten unserer Einheiten
* Ein Arbeitsort direkt am Hauptbahnhof
* Die Stelle ist in Lohnklasse 20 eingereiht (Informationen zum Lohnsystem).
### Bewerbung ###
Schick uns deine Bewerbung direkt über unser Online-Tool (für diese Stelle berücksichtigen wir keine Bewerbungen über Personaldienstleistungsunternehmen). Bei Fragen zur Stelle kannst du dich gerne an Samuel Klaus, Leiter Recht Digital, wenden (043 259 25 43, samuel.klaus@ji.zh.ch).

**Employeur solide et tourné vers l'avenir, la Vaudoise est l'un des assureurs leaders en Suisse. Fidèle à sa nature coopérative et à ses valeurs, elle encourage la création d'un environnement de travail sain, inclusif et inspirant, idéal pour développer votre talent.**
La Vaudoise s'est engagée dans un parcours de transformation digitale dans le but d'accroître la qualité du service offert à ses clientes et clients en répondant à leurs nouvelles attentes tout en améliorant l'efficacité de ses processus.
Dans ce contexte, nous souhaitons renforcer notre équipe Software Quality & Delivery avec la recherche d'un/e Quality & FinOps Manager (h/f/x) - 80-100% dont la mission centrale sera d'élever le niveau de maturité technique et opérationnel de nos équipes applicatives.
Face à des systèmes d'information en constante évolution, la maîtrise de la dette technique et l'excellence applicative sont devenues des enjeux stratégiques. Vous serez le/la garant/e d'une approche structurée et durable de la qualité logicielle en pilotant des initiatives transverses à fort impact.
**Les missions qui vous attendent :**
* Définir et formaliser une stratégie globale de réduction de la dette technique en lien avec les priorités métier et les contraintes des équipes
* Identifier, qualifier et prioriser les composantes de la dette technique à travers l'ensemble du portefeuille applicatif et proposer des plans d'action mesurables
* Construire et maintenir une roadmap d'obsolescence applicative claire et à jour, couvrant l'ensemble des applications et des technologies (frameworks, librairies, langages, systèmes, plateformes, ...)
* Assurer l'implémentation et l'intégration du framework FinOps au sein des pratiques Cloud de l'entreprise
* Piloter les phases de décommissionnement applicatif en coordination avec les parties prenantes techniques et métier
* Veiller à l'adoption effective de ces processus au sein des équipes applicatives en levant les obstacles et en adaptant les approches au contexte de chaque équipe
* Accompagner les équipes en tant que coach et référent qualité en animant des sessions de formation, de sensibilisation et de retour expérience
* Définir et suivre des KPI de qualité et de dette technique et les restituer au management lors des séances de suivi
* Animer des comités transverses réguliers avec les équipes applicatives et les instances de gouvernance pour maintenir l'alignement sur les objectifs qualité
* Assurer la coordination technique en partenariat avec le chef de projet technique dans le but d'aligner la qualité, les délais et les objectifs de livraison
**Votre profil :**
* Formation supérieure en informatique type HES, Bachelor / Master, EPFL
* Expérience confirmée de 5 ans minimum dans un rôle lié à la qualité logicielle ou au pilotage technique
* Maîtrise de l'implémentation du framework FinOps en entreprise, attestée par la certification FinOps Certified Professional
* Expérience avérée dans la gestion d'environnements applicatifs complexes et dans la conduite de programmes de modernisation
* Maîtrise des enjeux de dette technique, d'obsolescence et de refactoring dans des systèmes d'information de taille significative
* Bonne connaissance des pratiques DevOps, CI/CD, des outils d'analyse de code (SonarQube) et des pratiques agiles (Scrum)
* Capacité à construire et animer des tableaux de bord et KPI de qualité orientés décision
* Compréhension solide des architectures orientées services, des enjeux de sécurité applicative et du cycle de vie logiciel
* Leadership naturel et capacité à fédérer des équipes pluridisciplinaires autour d'objectifs communs
* Excellentes qualités de communication et de vulgarisation, aussi bien avec les équipes techniques qu'avec le management
* Rigueur, sens de l'organisation et orientation résultats
* Esprit d'initiative, autonomie et force de proposition pour améliorer en continu les pratiques en place
* Bonne maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral
**Nous vous offrons:**
* Un environnement de travail sain dans une entreprise mutualiste labelisée "Meilleur Employeur".
* Des avantages sociaux multiples dont la flexibilité dans l'organisation du travail
* Un travail au sein d'une équipe dynamique et passionnée
* Des valeurs humaines centrées sur le bien-être des collaborateurs

## **Das kannst du bewirken** ##
* Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für anspruchsvolle Projekte im Bereich Molkereitechnik, Processing und Packaging - von der Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme.
* Investitionsprojekte führst du souverän, budget- und termingerecht und triffst dabei fundierte technische Entscheidungen.
* Als zentrale Ansprechperson koordinierst du interne Fachbereiche sowie externe Partner und stellst einen reibungslosen Projektverlauf sicher.
* Bestehende Anlagen und Prozesse hinterfragst du kritisch und entwickelst nachhaltige, wirtschaftlich sinnvolle Optimierungen.
* Bei technischen Herausforderungen oder Produktionsstörungen bringst du deine Erfahrung gezielt ein und sorgst für stabile, langfristige Lösungen.
* Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Compliance-Vorgaben hast du jederzeit im Blick und integrierst sie konsequent in deine Projekte.
## **Das bringst du mit** ##
* Eine fundierte Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung auf Stufe HFP/HF oder vergleichbar im Bereich Lebensmittel oder Technik.
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich der Lebensmittelindustrie ermöglicht es dir, Projekte eigenständig und mit hoher Fachkompetenz zu führen.
* Du verfügst über tiefgehende Kenntnisse im Bereich der Verfahrens- und Verpackungstechnik.
* In Deutsch kommunizierst du sicher und klar; auch auf Englisch bewegst du dich souverän.
* Deine Arbeitsweise ist analytisch und leistungsorientiert - kombiniert mit Entscheidungsstärke und Verantwortungsbewusstsein.
* Unternehmerisches Denken, ein ausgeprägtes Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsdenken sowie deine Bereitschaft zu Einsätzen ausserhalb der regulären Arbeitszeit runden dein Profil ab.
## **Das bieten wir dir** ##
**5 Wochen Ferien**
Geniesse fünf Wochen Ferien pro Jahr. Ab dem 46. Lebensjahr steigert sich dein Urlaubsanspruch schrittweise auf bis zu sechs Wochen.
**Freiwillige Erfolgsbeteiligung**
Je nach Geschäftserfolg erhältst du eine freiwillige Erfolgsbeteiligung. Damit möchten wir deinen wertvollen Beitrag zum Unternehmenserfolg anerkennen.
**Weiterbildung & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten**
Bei Emmi steht die Weiterentwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden im Vordergrund: Wir bieten Talentprogramme, unterstützen Aus- und Weiterbildungen und fördern alle Kompetenzen für dein berufliches Wachstum. Erfahre hier mehr über unsere Entwicklungsangebote.
**Günstige Verpflegung im Personalrestaurant**
Für Frühstück, Mittagessen und Pausenverpflegung steht dir ein Personalrestaurant mit vergünstigten Mitarbeitendenpreisen zur Verfügung.
**Vergünstigungen**
Profitiere von bis zu 20 % Rabatt auf Emmi Produkte, attraktiven Freizeit- und Reisevergünstigungen, Sonderangeboten bei Topmarken sowie Flottenrabatten beim Autokauf.
**Kostenlose Parkplätze**
Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden gratis Parkplätze am Standort.

## Dein Bewerbungsprozess ##
Eingang deiner Bewerbung
Sobald deine Bewerbung online bei uns eingetroffen ist, erhältst du eine Eingangsbestätigung. Wir nehmen uns Zeit, jede Bewerbung sorgfältig zu prüfen. Sobald wir unsere Vorauswahl getroffen haben, geben wir dir zeitnah Bescheid.
Persönliches Kennenlernen
Wir freuen uns, dich im Rahmen eines persönlichen Gesprächs vor Ort kennenzulernen.
Probetag im Betrieb
Ein Probetag gibt dir die Möglichkeit, dein zukünftiges Arbeitsumfeld, deine Aufgaben und dein Team kennenzulernen. Gleichzeitig können wir so besser einschätzen, wie gut du zu uns passt.
Finaler Entscheid & Vertragsausstellung
Bei einer Zusage freuen wir uns, dir mündlich ein Vertragsangebot zu unterbreiten. Wenn wir uns einig sind, senden wir dir die Vertragskonditionen per E-Mail zu und bereiten deinen digitalen Arbeitsvertrag vor - der Beginn zahlreicher gemeinsamer Emmi Momente.

s.t:
Uma frase que nos define - Somos especialistas em soluções de TI e apaixonados por inovação! 🚀
Ao infinito e além - Somos #semfronteiras . Nosso time está espalhado pelo Brasil e pelo mundo 🌎
Nossa cultura - Mesmo distantes, estamos juntos 🧡 Temos cerimônias para estarmos mais próximos, compartilhar conhecimento e ficar por dentro das novidades da nossa empresa!
Somos diversos - Um dos nossos compromissos é fazer da companhia um ambiente cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e respeitoso, valorizando e promovendo a pluralidade. Por isso, aqui temos espaço para todas as pessoas, independente de raça, gênero, idade, orientação sexual, crença religiosa ou deficiência. 🏳️‍🌈👩🏾‍🦽
Nosso objetivo - Potencializar os negócios dos nossos clientes através de soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis. Topa vir com a gente nessa? 🎯
Sobre a posição
Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como Technical Project Manager , responsável pela condução de projetos enterprise de Digital Commerce , combinando gestão de projetos, relacionamento com stakeholders e sólida capacidade técnica.
A posição terá papel central na conexão entre negócio, produto e tecnologia, garantindo clareza de escopo, planejamento, alinhamento entre equipes e qualidade das decisões técnicas ao longo do projeto.
Esperamos uma pessoa com experiência relevante em e-commerce B2C e B2B , conhecimento avançado da plataforma VTEX e capacidade para participar ativamente da definição de arquiteturas de solução e integrações. Perfil esperado
Procuramos uma pessoa que não atue apenas no acompanhamento operacional do projeto. O Technical Project Manager deve possuir profundidade técnica suficiente para compreender as soluções propostas, questionar decisões, identificar riscos e conduzir discussões de arquitetura , sem necessariamente assumir a responsabilidade pela implementação.
Também esperamos forte capacidade de relacionamento com clientes e stakeholders, organização para atuar em ambientes complexos e habilidade para transformar discussões técnicas e de negócio em planos de execução claros e objetivos.
Principais responsabilidades
Planejar e conduzir projetos enterprise de Digital Commerce , acompanhando escopo, cronograma, riscos, dependências e entregas.
Atuar como principal ponto de conexão entre stakeholders de negócio, times técnicos e demais áreas envolvidas no projeto.
Gerenciar escopo, prioridades e expectativas, conduzindo negociações com stakeholders quando houver mudanças, riscos ou conflitos de prioridade.
Conduzir cerimônias e processos de desenvolvimento utilizando Scrum e metodologias ágeis .
Estruturar planos de trabalho, acompanhar evolução das entregas e garantir visibilidade clara sobre status, riscos e próximos passos.
Traduzir necessidades de negócio em direcionamentos compreensíveis para os times técnicos.
Participar da definição e revisão de arquiteturas de solução , considerando requisitos funcionais, integrações, escalabilidade e restrições da plataforma.
Conduzir agendas técnicas relacionadas a arquiteturas de integração e fluxo de dados entre VTEX, ERPs, CRMs, OMS, sistemas de pagamento, logística, marketplaces e demais plataformas corporativas.
Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos, desenvolvedores e especialistas para avaliar alternativas técnicas e apoiar decisões de solução.
Garantir alinhamento entre arquitetura, escopo acordado e objetivos de negócio.
Identificar antecipadamente riscos técnicos ou funcionais que possam impactar prazo, escopo ou qualidade da solução.
Organizar e conduzir workshops, refinamentos técnicos, sessões de discovery e alinhamentos de arquitetura.
Estruturar roteiros de demonstração , preparando cenários que evidenciem as principais capacidades e entregas do projeto.
Realizar demos, apresentações executivas e reuniões de acompanhamento com clientes, lideranças e diretorias.
Comunicar temas técnicos de forma clara para públicos não técnicos, contextualizando impactos, riscos e decisões.
Requisitos
Excelente capacidade de comunicação, organização e planejamento .
Experiência comprovada na gestão e condução de projetos enterprise .
Experiência prática com Scrum e metodologias ágeis .
Experiência com gestão de escopo, riscos, dependências e negociação com stakeholders.
Experiência com projetos de e-commerce B2C e B2B .
Inglês fluente , com capacidade para conduzir reuniões, apresentações e discussões técnicas.
Conhecimento técnico avançado da plataforma VTEX e de seus principais componentes e capacidades.
Conhecimento técnico avançado suficiente para elaborar, discutir e validar arquiteturas de solução .
Experiência com arquiteturas de integração entre plataformas de e-commerce e sistemas corporativos.
Capacidade de compreender APIs, integrações, eventos, fluxos de dados e dependências entre sistemas.
Experiência conduzindo reuniões técnicas com arquitetos, desenvolvedores, equipes de integração e stakeholders de negócio.
Capacidade de produzir materiais executivos e apresentar soluções, entregas e decisões para públicos de liderança.

Marketing & Sales

Pourquoi ce poste est fait pour toi?
Tu as envie de comprendre aussi bien l’aspect technique que le business sales. Tu souhaite réfléchir à la configuration et aux solutions avec les devs ET parler efficacité commerciale avec les sales managers.
Le contexte
Ce poste fait partie de Sales Strategy & Operations, l'équipe centrale qui pilote toute la stratégie revenue de Pennylane. C'est une équipe de 10 personnes, et tu participeras au succès et de la scalabilité de notre machine commerciale.
Le poste
L’objectif est de devenir une source d’informations et solutions pour l’équipe Sales, les débloquer, et les rendre toujours plus efficaces.
Pour cela, tu vas aider à comprendre leurs contraintes, prioriser, et piloter les projets qui impactent vraiment leur productivité (configurations Salesforce, intégrations outils, optimisations, IA...).
Avec une forte dimension apprentissage et projet, tu vas monter progressivement en expertise sur notre stack (Salesforce, Modjo, ChiliPiper, Ringover, Dust...) et devenir clé pour que l'équipe Sales scale efficacement.
Missions principales
Tu seras le point de référence technique pour l'équipe Sales (100+ personnes) sur tous les sujets CRM et outils commerciaux. Tes responsabilités principales:
Comprendre les besoins des équipes Sales - Identifier les problématiques qui ralentissent ou limitent les commerciaux (productivité Salesforce, workflow d'appels, pipeline accuracy...)
Qualifier et prioriser - Challenger les demandes, saisir ce qui a vrai impact, et prioriser avec le reste de l'équipe Sales Strat & Ops
Piloter les projets - De la spécification à la mise en production : cadrer, planifier, coordonner avec l'équipe tech, tester, communiquer, et accompagner la conduite du changement
Supporter les utilisateurs - Assurer un support efficace et scalable sur Salesforce et les outils satellites. Identifier les patterns et les opportunités d'optimisation.
Monter en expertise - Apprendre progressivement les méthodologies de gestion de projet, l’analyse data, Salesforce et comment les équipes commerciales fonctionnent vraiment.
Note: Nous cherchons quelqu'un avec le goût d'apprendre, pas quelqu'un qui sait déjà tout!
Profil recherché
Junior avec une petite expérience (1-2 ans) OU profil en transition vers les outils CRM/Sales Ops
Profil technico-fonctionnel - à l'aise aussi bien avec le technique qu'avec le métier
Curiosité et soif d'apprendre - tu aimes découvrir et maîtriser de nouveaux outils/concepts
Ouverture d'esprit - tu as envie d’apprendre différentes perspectives (tech ET business)
Process de recrutement
Screening Interview avec Nathalie - Talent Acquisition - 30 minutes.
Manager Interview avec Maud - Associate Team Lead Technical Partner - 45 minutes.
Business Case direct avec Maud et un autre membre de l'équipe - 1 heure.
Final Round avec Nicolas - Head of Sales Ops et un autre membre de l'équipe - 45 minutes.

In this role you will oversee Blue Cross NC ’s Vendor Integration program for clients requesting employer-specific integrations with their third-party vendors. Provide full end-to-end program management including strategic planning, needs analysis, resource development, implementation oversight, and ongoing monitoring and optimization.

Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders on vendor integration initiatives to positively impact the group market offer and relationships with our clients and agency partners. What You'll Do
Manage Blue Cross NC ’s employer-specific Vendor Integration offerings, including integration options, pricing, and intake forms and processes.
Oversee all employer-specific vendor integrations at the enterprise level, including tracking all active, requested and in-progress vendor integrations and taking action to address any identified issues. Ensure that existing integrations are updated or terminated as client needs or client/vendor/agency partnerships change.
Identify, analyze and understand client goals and the specific requirements for each new vendor integration request. Ensure that new vendor integration requests are triaged quickly and routed to the appropriate team to implement.
Develop and manage relationships with both internal partners and external stakeholders to successfully implement and maintain highly complex vendor integrations to meet the needs of our clients.
Coordinate interdepartmental functions to minimize implementation delays; work with program/project team members on a regular basis to review deliverables and ensure deadlines are met.
Oversee and optimize all data integration processes for group-contracted third-party vendors, including ensuring that the appropriate fees are charged to support these integrations. Serve as the primary point person to address questions and concerns about these processes (including integration options, pricing/billing, status and issue triage).
Drive program enhancements and process improvements through proactive consultation and collaboration with internal stakeholders.
Lead a cross-functional group vendor integration team in maintaining a centralized repository of all active, in-progress and terminated group vendor integrations, identifying interdependencies, communicating program requirements, tracking progress, making decisions, and resolving conflicts and issues.
Establish and monitor performance metrics and goals for the Vendor Integration program, including process measures, outcomes measures and financial measures. Document and present program results through operational reports, outcomes studies, presentations and publications.
Direct the development and maintenance of plans, practices and assignments to identify, quantify and contain the occurrence and potential impact of risks and risk events on the execution of the Vendor Integration program and Sales Intake projects, and their likelihood of success.
Develop and manage budgets to control expenditures in accordance with budget allocations, together with the conformance to timing, limits and usage of funding as agreed upon in the spending plan for the assigned program(s).
Ensure the program meets appropriate regulatory and accreditation standards, fully cooperates with organizational governance functions and provides oversight for the definition and exercise of regular iteration and reporting required by organizational governance policies.

Nebius is looking for a Delivery Manager t o lead the delivery of physical security projects across our global data center portfolio. This role is responsible for coordinating the successful execution of projects from planning through commissioning and handover, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and according to technical and operational requirements.
Unlike a traditional Project Manager, the Delivery Manager focuses on driving execution, coordinating cross-functional teams, removing delivery obstacles, and ensuring all stakeholders remain aligned throughout the project lifecycle.
The role requires regular travel and onsite presence for at least 50% of the time during critical phases of construction and commissioning to ensure successful project delivery.
Experience with data center construction , particularly from a physical security perspective , is a strong advantage.

Identify and resolve project issues, manage risks, and drive mitigation plans.
Create clear visibility into project health, milestones, risks, and overall progress through regular reporting.
Provide regular project status updates to the PMO and Regional Manager for Physical Security.
Ensure delivered solutions meet quality, operational, and security standards.
Continuously improve delivery processes and project documentation.
